notes.title: Changelog - 2-20-2022
notes.notes:
-Fixed a crash with stale bookmarks
-Fixed an issue where choice conditions weren't properly evaluating in a wizard
-Added popup hints on stat blocks so you don't have to edit them to see where they are targeting
-Added the ability to remotely link stat blocks to other pages

notes.title: CHANGELOG 2/7/2022
notes.notes:
-Fixed and issue where you couldn't reference dice roll faces or total dice rolls from variables
-Added helper messages into the checkbox prompts to make things more clear
-Component's onExit and onEnter events now refer to the page that has the component using '#' and refer to the page being moved within the components with '@'

notes.title: CHANGELOG 2/5/2022
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue with components not firing their onExit events when transferring items
-Added a delete option when right clicking on components
-Added an "open In Data-view option" from the wiki 
-Components only show their keyname in edit mode now

notes.title: Changelog 12-15-21
notes.notes:
-Quick fix for F2P not working after downloading workshop content
-Added an Option to remove box shadow on images for better in line styling

notes.title: CHANGELOG 11-22-21
notes.notes:
-Reverted removal of the page sidebar, instead only show it during editing
-Changed settings to dataview for pages
-Added a new Event builder to help guide event creation a little better

notes.title: CHANGELOG 11-17-21
notes.notes:
+Connected into the Cloud compendium a bit for system sharing
+Refactored Chat to be cleaner
+Reorganized system building a bit
+Updated the event builder for more user friendly options
+Buried Meta data for a cleaner view
+Moved bookmarks into a "table of contents" popup
+Added a system for storing tracker pre-sets
+Added some system skeletons for d20 and d100 systems
+Added a feedback button to help us catch bugs and issues
+Added Data View for managing internal stats and formulas

notes.title: Changelog 11-4-2021
notes.notes:
CHANGELOG 11-4-2021
+Added Project details and system Association
+Added Actionbar for common automation shortcuts
+Added a Toggle edit button to keep layouts from shifting while using automation
+Added the ability to change column size
+Added scramble macro to the event language
+Added rollable tables
+Added components that can help track things like equipment
+Added Fate Dice to the dice language
+Archives can be marked as GM Only so only the host will have access to them
+Refactored Project Settings into something more useable
+Added reformat for pages
+Added system building options

notes.title: Major Multiplayer Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40989880/49fea1d4309200f1a3ab052dfe36f9748084c2cf.png

A ton of work was done this patch, adding a bunch of dynamic systems that pretty much entirely changes how you can use the tool. 

Enjoy! Documentation and tutorials to follow soon. Mythic Archive Wiki will be expanded on as time goes on too!


CHANGELOG 10-15-2021
+Videos support to embed in articles
+Added Permissions / Multiplayer
+New pin styles
+Custom marker/area coloring
+Added Experimental Trackers
+Added Experimental Web multiplayer (join at https://app.mythicarchive.net)
+Added a reactive event builder to help with setting up automation
+Added GM Roll to Events
+Added a create button to the search bar
+Added '/addon/' directory in preparation for file/project sharing
+Added in-line events for chat output
+Added chat animations
+Added Wallpapers and Sync Player
-Fixed an issue where tooltips weren't closing properly
-Fixed a bug where markers would duplicate when editing
-Fixed an issue where events that use automation from a project were duplicating the event script
-Fixed a bug with tables not being added in the correct spot on
-Fixed a bug with embedded links not being added in the correct spot
-Visual Tweaking for improved readability

notes.title: CHANGELOG 10-2-21
notes.notes:
+Added spell check
+Added metadata area for compendium viewed pages
+Added scroll functionality to bookmarks
-Changed styling on wiki search bar
-Touched up padding and minor style changes for profile pages
-Replaced settings button from pages

notes.title: CHANGELOG 10-1-21
notes.notes:
CHANGELOG 10-1-21
+Added Tabs to Pages
+Improved overall performance of the wiki list
+When switching archives the project name will change to make things more clear
+Added ability to copy the format of another article
-Formats Renamed to Templates
-Compacted the wiki list a bit 
-Fixed a bug that caused the app to crash when dragging wiki entries
